_comment: Real, complete meta-gem activation requirements for every meta gem in the game - transcribed verbatim from wowsims' own authoritative source (sim/tbc-new/ui/core/proto_utils/gems.ts, MetaGemCondition definitions), not invented or guessed. The sim's own Go engine does NOT model or check these at all (a meta gem's stat bonus applies unconditionally in-sim regardless of real activation state - confirmed via item_effects.go) - this table exists so this tool's own gem CHOICES respect real, in-game meta-gem activation, matching what a real player actually needs socketed for the bonus to be real. 'type' is either 'min_colors' (needs at least minRed/minYellow/minBlue of each, simultaneously) or 'compare_colors' (needs strictly more of compareGreater than compareLesser) - the two real condition shapes wowsims' own MetaGemCondition class supports.
